paragraphs: Chapter 980
242nd Episode: Eltiot (3)
"My... disciple?"

"Didn't we make a promise? The one who loses must unconditionally follow one request of the other. Therefore, you have just become a disciple of this Eltiot. Of course, teaching someone like you, who falls short of the standards, is indeed a sad task for me. But what can I do? Fate has cruelly brought us together like this."
"Ha, are you really going to take me as a disciple, Elti...?"
"Squeak!"
Luna was disoriented by the repeated scolding.
"Why, why again?"

"From the beginning, a disciple should never even step on the shadow of their master. But you dared to casually call your master by his name? That should never happen. Even if the Sun God dies and chaos descends on the world, there are customs that an intelligent being must adhere to."
At this point, Jin, Veradin, and Dante were trying so hard to suppress their laughter that their faces looked about to burst.
'I mustn't laugh, I must endure... But I never expected Eltiot to defeat sister like this.'
In fact, Jin had not considered Luna's defeat.
He expected Eltiot, who was wounded, to show a performance that even Luna had to recognize, and he anticipated a warm conclusion.

"Cough! Choke! I'm so stunned that my internal injuries are acting up. Don't you think to hand me a handkerchief while your master is vomiting blood like this? And what's with the casual language when you know my age?"
Luna handed him a handkerchief.
As Eltiot coughed and spat blood for a while, Luna collected her thoughts and recalled what he had said.
'The most excellent sword is like the wind...'
It was not a difficult concept.
The wind could become a storm that destroys mountains or a sharp breeze that tears an opponent in an instant.
A sword like the wind, of course, had to be the most flexible sword.
One that could change into any form.
'The epitome of elegance, Eltiot showed me such a sword.'
The sword of Runcandel is cold and destructive.
Although there are elegant sword movements within the decisive techniques or regular skills, it is not the mainstream.
Luna, who always crushed her opponents with overwhelming power, was particularly lacking in this aspect.
Meanwhile, Eltiot continued to scold, and the rest of the party was trying to calm him down.
Finally, Luna approached Eltiot and bowed her head.
"A promise is a promise. Alright, El... No, should I now address you as Master?"
"Hmph! Finally, you speak like an intelligent being. If you had messed up once more, I would have snapped."
“I should have used informal language one more time......”
“Since we've already called each other master and disciple once, it's irreversible. It's truly lamentable, but what can be done?”
Eltiot sat upright and looked up at Luna.
“Shouldn't you bow?”
“Bow?”

“Originally, in our Clear Sky Tribe, when the oath of a master and disciple is made, it is customary for the disciple to visit the master every morning and bow. But times have changed, so I've decided to accept a bow just once instead. I'm considering your status in society as well, so be grateful for this master's consideration.”
By now, Luna was no longer surprised. She sighed and looked at Jin.
For a rider of Runcandel to bow to someone else, it required the permission of the Grand Lord or the regent.
“Eltiot.”
“Why do you call me?”
“Lady Luna is immeasurably precious to me. If she bows, then she truly becomes your disciple, doesn't she?”
“That's right.”

“As your reason for being a master, you should not treat Lady Luna carelessly, ignore her, or undermine her dignity in front of others, like now. And this is not a request; it's a warning. It's coming from the Grand Lord of Runcandel.”

“You worry too much. Although she may be below the standard, a disciple is a disciple. That means she's the one to inherit this Eltiot. Ignoring my disciple would be like spitting on my own face, and if someone undermines her dignity, it undermines mine as well. However.”
“However?”

“When we are close and comfortable with only disciples and friends around, like today, I will scold her as I please. She may be your precious sister, but to me, she is a disciple with more than one or two things to fix. Do you think it will be easy to correct her breathing and everything else? Especially since she's been living her life praised without knowing her own problems. Then again, you probably haven't properly taught anyone either.”
This time, Jin looked at Luna. Luna seemed to shrug in acceptance of Eltiot's intentions.
“Whew, well then. I will bow.”
“Alright.”
Luna slowly bowed.
And at the moment when she was about to rise, the jewel in Eltiot's chest glowed, and a person's figure was briefly etched in the center.
It was the image of Luna.
“That foolish and ignorant person, who doesn't even know the meaning of etching a person into the Clear Sky Tribe's chest, has finally become my disciple. Now, let's move on to the next ritual.”
“Is there another ritual?”
“Yes. Jin, where did you place the bodies of my brothers?”
“I have placed them in the mortuary of the Royal Medical Chamber.”
“Guide me, my disciple. Let's go there.”
In the mortuary, there were 59 bodies of the Clear Sky Tribe, brought from the royal hideaway.
“Everyone but my disciple and me, please leave for a moment.”
Except for the two of them, the rest of the group left the mortuary.
Luna looked at Eltiot's quiet face. He looked at the coffins of his brothers with calm eyes.
He weeps with his heart.
It's a commonly used expression in this world.
But Luna was not only witnessing the expression; she was directly observing Eltiot weeping with his heart.
Eltiot's heart's jewel was ceaselessly glowing, etching the shapes of people inside it.
The images of his dead brothers.
With every forming and fading of an image, sparks flowed from the jewel like tears.
He was facing sorrow in the way of the Clear Sky Tribe.
Luna bowed her head in silence.
“......It's done now. Let's bury our brothers on a good day sometime.”
“Let's do that.”

“Next time, we should bring a pig's head. When we offer sacrifices to the dead, we liked to place a pig's head on the altar in the way of the small tribes and stick money in its nostrils. We believed it would help the dead live well in the afterlife.”
“That's an interesting custom. In some regions of this world, money is also placed on the corpse.”
“Remember, it's a pig's head.”
“Yes, a pig's head.”
“You do have a clever side. Now, let's go back to training.”
“Shouldn't you get treatment first?”
“Time is of the essence if you intend to break through my walls. The Melka tribe has been defeated, and the Red Sky Tribe is on the rise again, so their god will soon appear.”
The god of the Red Sky Tribe.
The Vamel Union still had no idea of his whereabouts.
Whether he had survived in Daebong, if so, where he was, what state he was in, etc., nothing was known.
It was just perceived that there wouldn't be an immediate problem, as the Red Sky Tribe hadn't summoned their god even when pressed several times.

“At the meeting, there was already talk that the Red Sky Tribe had regained strength during the Meisil battle, so perhaps they might now bring forth their god since they would have gathered a large amount of blood. You seem entirely certain, Master.”
“Yes, he's alive.”
“How do you know?”
"The royal family was using him. That's what I heard when he was brainwashed."
"So you didn't see it firsthand."
"One thing's for sure. Maybe in as short as a week, or at most two weeks, he will appear."
"That soon?"

"He's exceptional. Even at my prime, I cannot be sure to best him. But more importantly, it's his leadership and strategy. In ancient times, we were slightly losing to the Red Plutonian tribe, because of him. And you, as my disciple, have the duty to defeat him."
"Even without you, our alliance has many reasons to bring him down. Then, do you also know where this Red Plutonian tribe god is?"
Temple of the Second Sun, Sun God Church.
"Priest Luke."
Sanna sought Luke.
Luke, dressed in the robes of the Sun God Church, was kneeling before the sacred statue of the Sun God.
The statue depicted various forms of the Sun God, and at its center was a human figure holding something that gleamed like gold.
It was a fragment of the Sun God's shattered physical form. Particles flowed from the fragment, gradually seeping into Luke.
Without responding, Luke continued to be engrossed in his prayer.
'...He has prayed in front of this statue every day since that day, but is the wound still this deep?'
Sanna thought as she looked at Luke's back.
The white robe covering his back was completely soaked in crimson blood.
The dripping blood pooled at his feet, soaking his pants.
Two hours passed before Luke finally turned to look at Sanna.

"...Just now, my bones barely mended. It's certain. When Jin Runcandel reached enlightenment, he bore the will of regeneration just like the Sun God. That's what hinders the power of this sacred body and delays the healing."
"But it's strange. If Jin Runcandel was so imbued with the Sun God's will, he should already be normal. Wasn't there no sign of him being consumed by the Sun God in Meysil?"

-'Being a part of' isn't the right phrase. 'Being consumed by', or 'being buried by' might be more apt. If he's consumed by the Sun God, he will have no choice but to be with us. Even if neither he nor we want that.
-That makes sense. Oh... That would certainly help the revival of the Sun God Church.
The conversation Luke and Sanna had when Jin reached enlightenment.
However, contrary to Luke's expectations, Jin, even with a strand of the Sun God's will, remained unchanged.
"Yes, there was no sign. Until the reason becomes clear, it might be best to avoid direct combat with him. It's been a while since I felt the threat of death..."

"Whew. Then we can hope for two things. Either Jin Runcandel naturally gets consumed by the Sun God, or other powerful enemies deal with him on our behalf. Like Orgal, Zipple, Ganesto, and the Red Plutonian tribe. Now we can even have hopes for the Red Plutonian tribe. I heard from Ailan that their god, Shimat, will awaken in a few days."
